大清真寺建于 1302—1303 年，是卡拉曼政权早期的建筑。1339 年，穆萨埃米尔兴建托尔经学院，其石造门廊成为城中另一处醒目建筑。他后来葬于学校旁，王族其他成员也安葬在周围地区。这些基金会建筑显示，即使王朝权力扩展到安纳托利亚更广阔的区域，埃尔梅内克仍十分重要。卡拉曼国家消亡后，山城仍保留着这种赞助留下的建筑痕迹。

english: Ermioni is a small port on the southeastern shore of the Argolid. Ancient Hermione was known for its shipbuilders and for the costly purple dye made there. The traveller Pausanias described its sanctuaries and festivals, including an unusual shrine of Hestia with an altar but no image of the goddess. The town's reputation for shipbuilding and seamanship continued under Ottoman rule, and its maritime skills played a part in the Greek War of Independence.
simp_chinese: 埃米奥尼是阿尔戈利斯东南海岸的一座小港。古代的赫尔米奥涅以造船工匠和贵重的紫色染料闻名。旅行家保萨尼亚斯记述过这里的神庙和节庆，其中有一座少见的赫斯提亚圣所，里面设有祭坛，却没有女神的塑像。奥斯曼统治时期，城镇仍以造船与航海技术著称；希腊独立战争期间，这些海事技能也发挥了作用。

english:
Ernān is placed in the wider Rafsanjān country of Kermān, where roads crossed the dry plateau between Kermān and Yazd. Settlements in this region depended on access to water and on routes linking cultivated areas with neighbouring towns.

Rafsanjān's position on the Kermān–Yazd road made it an important regional centre. The town suffered attacks during the upheavals at the end of Safavid rule. Cotton cultivation also formed part of the district's agricultural economy, alongside exchange with other parts of Iran.
simp_chinese:
埃尔南位于克尔曼的拉夫桑詹广大地区，道路穿过干燥高原，连接克尔曼与亚兹德。当地聚落依靠水源，并借助道路将耕地与邻近城镇联系起来。

拉夫桑詹位于克尔曼—亚兹德道路上，因此成为地区中心。萨法维统治末年的动荡中，城市曾遭到攻击。棉花种植也是这一地区农业的一部分，当地与伊朗其他地区之间保持着交换联系。

english: Erode stands on the southern bank of the Kaveri in the Kongu country of southern India. The nearby Bhavani River joins the Kaveri upstream, and the rivers connect the town with the wider inland plain. Erode was held by Mysore in the eighteenth century, when the struggles of Haidar Ali and Tipu Sultan against the British brought repeated changes to the region. After the defeat of Tipu in 1799, Kongu came under the East India Company.
simp_chinese: 埃罗德位于南印度贡古地区、高韦里河南岸。附近的巴瓦尼河在上游汇入高韦里，河流将城镇与广阔的内陆平原连接起来。十八世纪，埃罗德归迈索尔统治；海德尔·阿里和蒂普苏丹与英国的斗争使这一地区屡次经历变化。1799年蒂普战败后，贡古地区转归东印度公司。

english:
Erongarícuaro stands on the western shore of Lake Pátzcuaro, where the lake country meets the wooded mountains of Michoacán. Its Purépecha name has been interpreted as a place of watching or waiting. Before the Spanish conquest it served as a fortified lakeside centre, guarding the western approaches to the Purépecha heartland.

After the conquest the district was granted in encomienda to Juan Infante, who disputed control of lakeside communities with Bishop Vasco de Quiroga. By 1575 Erongarícuaro had been placed under the jurisdiction of Pátzcuaro. A Franciscan church and convent were built in the later sixteenth century. The inhabitants supplied labour for lakeside estates and other enterprises, while the town remained linked to the neighbouring communities of the lake and mountains.
simp_chinese:
埃龙加里夸罗位于帕茨夸罗湖西岸，湖区在此与米却肯森林山地相接。其普雷佩查语名称被解释为守望或等待之地。西班牙征服之前，这里是湖畔的设防中心，守卫普雷佩查核心地区的西面通道。

征服后，该地区被授予胡安·因凡特作为恩科米恩达；他与主教巴斯科·德·基罗加长期争夺湖区聚落的控制权。到1575年，埃龙加里夸罗被置于帕茨夸罗管辖之下。方济各会教堂和修道院在十六世纪后期建成。居民为湖岸庄园和其他产业提供劳力，城镇也始终与湖畔及山地邻村保持联系。

english: The Eröö River flows through the forest and steppe of northern Mongolia before joining the Orkhon, a tributary of the Selenga. Rising in the Khentii Mountains, its waters pass through wooded uplands and valleys on their way west. The river belongs to a network of waterways that carries water from the Mongolian plateau northwards towards Lake Baikal, linking the country of the Khentii with the wider Selenga basin.
simp_chinese: 额勒河流经蒙古北部的森林与草原，随后汇入色楞格河支流鄂尔浑河。河水发源于肯特山，向西穿过有林的高地与河谷。这条河属于蒙古高原北流入贝加尔湖的水系，将肯特山地区与广阔的色楞格河流域联系起来。山间的支流和森林河谷，组成了这条北方水道的上游景观。

sources.title: encyclopedia of mongolia and the mongol.pdf

english: The Erri uplands form part of the mountainous interior of the Chukchi Peninsula. Rivers cut through tundra-covered slopes toward the Arctic coast, among them the Amguema, whose upper waters rush through canyons and rapids. Long winters cover the high ground in snow; in the brief summer, open valleys and low vegetation provide grazing for reindeer moving through the interior.
simp_chinese: 埃里高地是楚科奇半岛山地内陆的一部分。河流切过苔原覆盖的山坡，流向北极海岸，其中阿姆古埃马河上游穿过峡谷和急流。漫长冬季积雪覆盖高地，短暂夏季则让开阔河谷和低矮植被为内陆迁徙的驯鹿提供食物。

english: The northern Chukchi uplands descend toward the Arctic coast and the Long Strait, opposite Wrangel Island. Bare ridges and tundra valleys lie behind the headlands, including Cape Yakan on the coast. Rivers carry snowmelt northward through this cold country, while sea ice persists along the shore for much of the year. Reindeer travel across the inland pastures during the brief summer.
simp_chinese: 楚科奇北部高地向北极海岸与朗海峡倾斜，海峡对面是弗兰格尔岛。裸露山脊与苔原河谷位于海岸岬角后方，沿岸岬角包括亚坎角。河流将融雪带向北方，一年中大部分时间海冰停留在岸边。短暂夏季，驯鹿在内陆牧地行走。

english: Killala stands beside the bay that bears its name on the north coast of Mayo. An ancient ecclesiastical centre, it retains a round tower and was the seat of a bishop. In August 1798 the quiet town became the first objective of a French expedition sent to support the Irish rebellion. General Jean Humbert landed nearby at Kilcummin and took Killala; Bishop Joseph Stock met the general and chose to remain a prisoner rather than join the rebels. Stock later recorded what he had witnessed during the occupation.
simp_chinese: 基拉拉位于梅奥北岸同名海湾旁，是古老的教会中心，曾为主教驻地，城中有一座圆塔。1798 年 8 月，法国远征军前来支援爱尔兰起义，这座宁静小镇成为其首个目标。让·安贝尔将军在附近的基尔卡明登陆，随后占领基拉拉。主教约瑟夫·斯托克与将军会面，选择被拘留而不加入起义者，后来记下了占领期间的所见所闻。

english:
Erris Head marks the northern end of the Mullet Peninsula in County Mayo. Its sea approaches faced the Atlantic, close to the rocky passages between Blacksod Bay and Broadhaven. Early nineteenth-century efforts to improve navigation in these waters produced a substantial new landmark on nearby Eagle Island.

In 1830 Coast Guard commanders Blake and Glascock requested a light on Blackrock or Inishmann Point. Inspector George Halpin instead recommended Eagle Island, and Trinity House approved the choice that November. Two stone towers were constructed with their lanterns at the same level. Seen in alignment, the lights provided a guide past coastal dangers, including the Stags. They first shone on 29 September 1835. The exposed site made construction difficult: a heavy sea swept away part of the unfinished western tower and building materials. In January 1836 a wave-borne rock broke a lantern pane and extinguished the western light, which the keepers restored within an hour. The new navigation system remained dependent on constant work against the Atlantic.
simp_chinese:
埃里斯角位于梅奥郡马利特半岛北端，外侧面向大西洋，邻近布莱克索德湾与布罗德黑文之间多礁的航路。十九世纪初，为改善这一带航行条件，人们在附近鹰岛建设灯塔。

1830年，海岸警卫队指挥官布莱克与格拉斯科克申请在黑岩或伊尼什曼角设置航标。监察官乔治·哈尔平建议改选鹰岛，圣三一航标局于当年十一月批准。两座石塔的灯室建在同一高度，航海者可借灯光重合的方向避开包括斯塔格斯礁在内的危险。1835年9月29日首次亮灯。施工期间，巨浪曾卷走未完工西塔的一部分和建材；1836年一月，浪携石块打破灯室玻璃，熄灭西灯，守塔人一小时内恢复照明。新航标始终需要人力抵御大西洋。

english: Erromango is a large, forested island in southern Vanuatu, north of Tanna. Its river valleys and bays open onto shores visited by James Cook in 1774. In the 1820s traders found valuable sandalwood on the island, drawing new visitors to its shores. Islanders had their own settlements, languages and relationships long before this trade, which brought both opportunities and conflict.
simp_chinese: 埃罗芒阿是瓦努阿图南部一座森林大岛，位于坦纳以北。河谷与海湾通向海岸，詹姆斯·库克于1774年曾到访这里。1820年代，商人在岛上发现珍贵檀香木，吸引新的来客。在这项贸易带来机会和冲突之前，岛民早已有自己的聚落、语言和社会关系。

english: Eruh lies in the mountainous country east of Siirt, between the upper Tigris and the valleys of Botan. Its district belonged to a landscape of Kurdish principalities whose rulers held strongholds among the ridges. After a succession of regional powers, the area entered the Ottoman Empire during the reign of Sultan Selim I in the early sixteenth century. The valleys and steep hills around Eruh gave the settlements of this frontier their distinctive setting.
simp_chinese: 埃鲁赫位于锡尔特以东的山地，在底格里斯河上游与博坦河谷之间。这里属于库尔德诸领地所在的地区，地方领主在山脊间控制着堡垒。历经多个地区性政权后，埃鲁赫一带于十六世纪初苏丹塞利姆一世在位时归入奥斯曼帝国。周围陡峭的丘陵与河谷，塑造了这片边疆聚落的面貌。

english: Èrvykynnot lies among the mountains at the head of the Gulf of the Cross, an inlet on the southern side of the Chukchi Peninsula. Its Chukchi name evokes sharp, hard ground. The gulf was placed on Russian maps in the seventeenth century and named by Vitus Bering's expedition in 1728. Its deep waters and surrounding tundra belong to a coast long used by reindeer herders and marine hunters.
simp_chinese: 埃尔维金诺特位于楚科奇半岛南侧十字湾湾顶的群山之间。其楚科奇语名称让人联想到尖锐坚硬的土地。十七世纪俄国地图已标出这一海湾，1728 年维图斯·白令的探险队为其命名。深邃湾水和周围苔原属于驯鹿牧民与海兽猎人长期活动的海岸。

english: Erzin lies in the upper country of the Tes River, where the steppe of southern Tuva meets the mountain and desert landscapes of the Uvs basin. The Tes flows west from the eastern highlands towards Uvs Nuur, an enclosed salt lake. Its valley forms part of a broad inland watershed whose grasslands, dunes and high mountains support a rich variety of wildlife.
simp_chinese: 额尔钦位于特斯河上游地区，图瓦南部草原在此与乌布苏盆地的山地、荒漠相接。特斯河从东方高地向西流入封闭的乌布苏盐湖。河谷属于一片广阔的内陆流域，草地、沙丘和高山共同为多种野生动物提供栖息地。

english:
Erzincan lies on a broad plain watered by the Karasu, the western branch of the Euphrates, with high mountains on either side. Roads crossing eastern Anatolia converged here, making the city an important prize for the rulers of the region. Its long history brought Armenian, Turkish and other communities together in a fertile basin exposed to both warfare and earthquakes.

At the end of the fourteenth century Erzincan was ruled by the emir Mutahharten, whose allegiance to Timur brought him into conflict with the Ottoman sultan Bayezid. The city later passed to the Qara Qoyunlu and Aq Qoyunlu; Uzun Hasan repaired its fortress in the fifteenth century. Ottoman and Safavid armies contested the region in the early sixteenth century before Ottoman rule was established. In 1784 a powerful earthquake struck Erzincan, causing widespread destruction in the city and its surroundings.
simp_chinese:
埃尔津詹位于卡拉苏河灌溉的广阔平原上，两侧群山环抱；卡拉苏河是幼发拉底河的西支。横贯安纳托利亚东部的道路在此交汇，使城市成为地区统治者争夺的重要目标。在漫长历史中，亚美尼亚人、土耳其人和其他社群共同生活于这片肥沃盆地，也承受战争和地震的威胁。

十四世纪末，埃米尔穆塔赫哈尔滕统治埃尔津詹，他对帖木儿的效忠使其与奥斯曼苏丹巴耶济德发生冲突。城市后来先后归黑羊和白羊政权，乌尊·哈桑于十五世纪修复城堡。十六世纪初，奥斯曼与萨法维军队争夺此地，最终奥斯曼统治得以确立。1784年强烈地震袭击埃尔津詹，城镇及周围地区遭受广泛破坏。

english:
Erzurum rises above a high plain at the meeting of routes from Anatolia, the Caucasus and Iran. Its fortress, mosques and richly ornamented madrasas testify to the many rulers who valued this commanding position. In a land of severe winters, caravans stopped here on the long journey between Iranian markets and the ports and cities of the Ottoman world.

After the collapse of Ilkhanid power, rival dynasties and repeated campaigns left the city badly damaged. The Ottomans secured Erzurum in the early sixteenth century and began rebuilding it after Süleyman's Persian campaign of 1534. It became the seat of a great frontier province and a base for armies marching towards Iran and Georgia. Peace also allowed merchants to carry Iranian goods westward through Erzurum, though renewed wars disrupted the trade. The city was a meeting place for merchants who dealt in goods moving in both directions across the frontier, and its provincial governors oversaw a wide territory.

In the Russo-Ottoman War of 1828–1829, Russian forces advanced across eastern Anatolia and occupied Erzurum. The Treaty of Adrianople returned it to the Ottoman Empire, but the occupation and the departure of Armenian inhabitants for Russian territory altered the city's life. Its fortress and caravan routes remained central to a town repeatedly shaped by the ambitions of neighbouring powers.
simp_chinese:
埃尔祖鲁姆耸立在高原平地之上，安纳托利亚、高加索与伊朗之间的道路在此交汇。堡垒、清真寺和装饰华丽的经学院见证了历代统治者对此地的重视。在冬季严寒的土地上，商队往返伊朗市场与奥斯曼世界的港口和城市，长途跋涉中会在这里停留。

伊儿汗国衰落后，敌对王朝的争斗与反复征战使城市严重受损。奥斯曼人于十六世纪初控制埃尔祖鲁姆，在苏莱曼1534年波斯战役后开始重建。这里成为辽阔边疆行省的治所，也是军队向伊朗和格鲁吉亚进军的基地。和平时期，商人也经由此城将伊朗货物运往西方，尽管新的战争常常中断贸易。商人在城中交换双向越境的货物，行省总督则管辖着广阔的地区。

1828—1829年俄奥战争中，俄军深入安纳托利亚东部并占领埃尔祖鲁姆。《亚得里亚堡条约》将城市归还奥斯曼帝国，但占领和亚美尼亚居民向俄国领土迁移改变了城市生活。堡垒与商队道路仍是这座屡受邻近强权争夺的城市的核心。

english: The waters off this arid Atlantic shore lie opposite the desert coast of northwestern Africa. The cold Canary Current flows south along the coast, while upwelling brings nutrient-rich water towards the surface. Fish thrive in these waters, in striking contrast to the dry lands and sparse vegetation immediately inland.
simp_chinese: 这片干旱大西洋海岸外的水域与西北非沙漠海岸相望。寒冷的加那利洋流沿岸南下，上升流把富含养分的水带到海面附近。海中鱼群繁盛，与紧邻海岸的干燥土地和稀疏植被形成鲜明对照。

english:
Esashi's Iwayadō stronghold commanded the northern edge of the Sendai domain. In the sixteenth century the local Esashi family served the Kasai, but lost its lands in 1590 after failing to join Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign. Under the later domain order, Iwayadō became the centre of a network of fortified sites and roads protecting the frontier with Morioka.

The town also prospered as a collection and distribution point for goods carried on the Kitakami River. Its commerce depended on river transport as well as routes joining nearby strongholds. Fire posed a recurring threat: the great Iwayadō fire of 1731 began a remembered sequence of destructive blazes. Prayers for recovery and protection from fire became associated with the festival of Akiba Shrine, joining the town's commercial life to a distinctive local religious observance.
simp_chinese:
江刺的岩谷堂要害扼守仙台藩北缘。十六世纪，当地江刺氏隶属葛西氏，但因未参加秀吉进攻小田原的战役，于1590年被没收领地。此后的藩政时期，岩谷堂成为联结周围要害与道路的中心，守卫同盛冈藩接壤的边界。

城镇也依靠北上川舟运，作为物资集散地而繁荣。商业既利用河运，也依靠连接邻近据点的道路。火灾构成反复出现的威胁：1731年岩谷堂大火，是当地记忆中一连串严重火灾的开端。祈求复兴与防火的愿望同秋叶神社祭礼结合，使城镇的商业生活与一项鲜明的地方宗教活动联系起来。

english: Esashi lies on the northern coast of Ezo, facing the Sea of Okhotsk. Its name is understood to come from an Ainu word for a cape. Japanese merchants reached the Sōya coast to trade with Ainu communities before the Matsumae domain formally established its trading district there in the late seventeenth century. Ships brought goods to exchange for local products, linking this remote shore with the trading networks of the southern island.
simp_chinese: 枝幸位于虾夷地北部海岸，面向鄂霍次克海。地名被认为源自阿伊努语中的海岬。松前藩在十七世纪后期正式设立宗谷交易场所以前，日本商人已到这片海岸与阿伊努社区交易。船只运来货物，换取当地物产，将偏远海岸同南方的贸易网络联系起来。

english: The Escatawpa rises in the wooded country west of the Tombigbee and winds southward toward the Gulf. Its name comes from a Choctaw expression for a place where cane is cut. After crossing the coastal plain, the river joins the Pascagoula, whose waters reach the Mississippi Sound. The Escatawpa belongs to a network of rivers fed by the streams and groundwater of the inland forests, carrying their waters through lowlands toward the sea.
simp_chinese: 埃斯卡托帕河发源于汤比格比河以西的林地，蜿蜒向南流往墨西哥湾。河名源自乔克托语，意为“砍伐芦苇的地方”。穿过沿海平原后，河水汇入帕斯卡古拉河，最终流向密西西比海峡。内陆森林的溪流与地下水补给着这一河网，水流穿过低地，奔向大海。

english: Eschenbach lies in the wooded uplands of the Upper Palatinate. It was mentioned as a market around 1150 and later came under the Wittelsbach dynasty. From 1353 to 1400 the town belonged to the lands known as New Bohemia; during this period Emperor Charles IV granted it town rights in 1358. Eschenbach passed to Palatine rule in the fifteenth century and later to the Electorate of Bavaria, retaining a town court with its own rights of administration.
simp_chinese: 埃申巴赫位于上普法尔茨林木覆盖的高地。约一一五〇年，它作为集市首次见于记载，后来归属维特尔斯巴赫家族。一三五三至一四〇〇年，城镇属于称为新波希米亚的领地；这段时期的一三五八年，皇帝查理四世授予它城市权。十五世纪，埃申巴赫转归普法尔茨统治，后来又属于巴伐利亚选侯国，同时保有享有自身行政权利的城市法院。

english:
Eschwege stands on the Werra, near an old ford on the road into Thuringia. A Frankish royal court guarded the crossing, and in 974 Emperor Otto II granted the court and settlement to his wife Theophanu. Her daughter Sophia founded a community of canonesses on the Cyriakusberg. Its tower survived the later dissolution of the foundation. Market and town rights followed in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, and cloth and leatherworking became important local trades.

The town passed to Hesse during the Thuringian-Hessian succession struggle. Landgrave Balthasar of Thuringia built a castle here in 1386, but Eschwege returned to Hesse in 1433. Its castle later became a residence for branches of the Hessian ruling house. Imperial troops sacked and burned much of the town in 1637 during the Thirty Years' War.
simp_chinese:
埃施韦格坐落在韦拉河畔，靠近通往图林根的古老渡口。法兰克王室曾在此设立宫廷，守卫河道；974年，皇帝奥托二世将宫廷和聚落赐予妻子狄奥法努。两人的女儿索菲娅后来在齐里亚库斯山上建立女修会。修会后来解散，其塔楼却得以留存。十二至十三世纪，聚落先后获得集市权和城市权，制呢与皮革业也逐渐兴盛。

图林根—黑森继承战争期间，埃施韦格归属黑森。图林根领地伯巴尔塔萨于1386年在此修筑城堡，但城市于1433年重归黑森。城堡后来成为黑森统治家族旁支的驻地。三十年战争中的1637年，帝国军队洗劫城镇，并放火焚毁了大片城区。

english: Escocesa Bay is a broad indentation on the northeastern coast of Hispaniola, between the headlands of Cabo Francés Viejo and Cabo Cabrón. The Samaná peninsula forms its eastern side, with mountains rising above the shore. Older maps depict the peninsula as an island, reflecting a former connection between this bay and Samaná Bay to the south. The open bay faces the Atlantic beyond the northern coast.
simp_chinese: 埃斯科塞萨湾是伊斯帕尼奥拉东北岸一处宽阔的海湾，位于旧法兰西角与卡夫龙角之间。萨马纳半岛构成其东侧，岸边群山耸立。旧地图曾将半岛绘作岛屿，反映了此湾与南面萨马纳湾之间过去存在的水路。开阔的海湾朝向北岸外的大西洋。

english: Escoria was an Indigenous chiefdom in the lowlands of central Panama, near the Santa María River and the Gulf of Parita. Its principal settlement was protected by palisades, and the surrounding lands held a substantial population. In the early sixteenth century the chiefdom encountered Spanish expeditions advancing westward along the Pacific side of the isthmus. Its ruler was connected by marriage to the neighboring lord of Parita, whose people also faced the invading forces.
simp_chinese: 埃斯科里亚是巴拿马中部低地的原住民酋邦，靠近圣玛丽亚河与帕里塔湾。主要聚落以木栅防护，周围地区也有众多居民。十六世纪初，酋邦遭遇沿地峡太平洋一侧向西推进的西班牙远征队。这里的首领与邻近的帕里塔领主有婚姻关系；帕里塔人同样面临入侵军队。

english: Escurial is a small settlement in the country south of Trujillo. In the late sixteenth century it belonged to the land governed from that city, but its inhabitants sought their own jurisdiction. Philip IV granted Escurial the rights of an independent town in 1627, and Charles II confirmed the privilege in 1687. By the end of the eighteenth century the royal town had its own council house, prison and archive.
simp_chinese: 埃斯库里亚尔是特鲁希略以南乡间的一处小聚落。十六世纪末，它属于由特鲁希略管辖的土地，但居民寻求独立的司法权。费利佩四世于1627年授予埃斯库里亚尔独立城镇的权利，卡洛斯二世又在1687年确认这一特许。到十八世纪末，这座直属王室的城镇已有自己的议事厅、监狱和档案室。

english: Eseejja is named for the Ese Eja, a river people of the Beni and Madre de Dios basins. Their name may be translated as “people” or “true people,” and their language belongs to the Tacanan family. Skilled navigators, they have travelled widely between the headwaters of the Tambopata and the rivers of the Beni basin, fishing, hunting and gathering along the way. Their history includes contact with Andean populations in the time of the Inca Empire.
simp_chinese: 埃塞哈得名于生活在贝尼河与马德雷德迪奥斯河流域的埃塞哈人。他们的名字可译为“人”或“真正的人”，其语言属于塔卡纳语族。埃塞哈人擅长舟行，往来于坦博帕塔河上游与贝尼河流域之间，沿途捕鱼、狩猎和采集。在印加帝国时代，他们已与安第斯地区的人群有所接触。

english: Eséka lies among the forested hills of Bassa country in southern Cameroon. A local explanation of its name recalls a meeting between two people living on opposite sides of the hills, who called each other sèga, a Bassa word for an equal or a person of the same age. Bassa traditions also tell of families dispersing from Ngog Lituba, the pierced rock remembered as an ancestral place, into the surrounding forest lands.
simp_chinese: 埃塞卡位于喀麦隆南部巴萨地区的森林丘陵之间。当地对地名的解释讲述，两个住在山丘两侧的人相遇时互称“塞加”，这个巴萨语词意为平等的人或同龄人。巴萨传统还讲述，各家族从被记作祖先之地的穿孔岩恩戈格利图巴散居到周围森林。

english: E'se'katik, a Mi'kmaw name associated with the place of clams, lies on a sheltered harbor on Nova Scotia's south shore. French settlers knew the area as Merligueche, while Mi'kmaq communities used the coast and its rich waters long before European settlement. In 1753 the British established Lunenburg here, bringing Protestant settlers from continental Europe. The new town stood on a peninsula beside the harbor, in a region where the expansion of British settlement met Mi'kmaw resistance.
simp_chinese: 埃塞卡蒂克是与蛤蜊出产地有关的米克马克语名称，位于新斯科舍南岸的一处避风港。法国移民称这一地区为梅尔利盖什；欧洲人定居前，米克马克社群早已利用这片海岸和丰富水域。1753年，英国人在此建立卢嫩堡，带来欧洲大陆的新教移民。新城坐落于港湾旁的半岛，英国聚落扩张在这一地区遭遇米克马克人的抵抗。

english:
Esfarayen was an old city of western Khorasan, set between the mountains and the cultivated plains on the approaches to Nishapur. Its ruined predecessor, known as Belqeys, preserves the outline of a substantial fortified settlement. The great earthen citadel with its towers stood within a wider town, a reminder of Esfarayen's place among the cities of the region.

In the sixteenth century Esfarayen lay in the path of the struggle between the Safavids and the Uzbek rulers of Transoxiana. By 1529 the Uzbek leader Ubayd Allah Khan controlled territory extending between Esfarayen and Balkh. The region remained exposed to the movements of armies across Khorasan, and its old city eventually fell into ruin. The surviving walls show the scale of the defences built to protect a town on this contested frontier.
simp_chinese:
埃斯法拉延是呼罗珊西部的一座古城，位于山地与通往内沙布尔的耕作平原之间。被称为比勒吉斯的旧城遗址保留着规模可观的设防聚落轮廓：高大的土筑城堡带有众多塔楼，周围曾是一片更广阔的城区，显示了埃斯法拉延在当地城市中的地位。

十六世纪，埃斯法拉延处在萨法维王朝与河中乌兹别克统治者争夺的道路上。到1529年，乌兹别克领袖乌拜杜拉汗控制了埃斯法拉延与巴尔赫之间的土地。这一地区长期受到穿越呼罗珊的军队影响，旧城最终荒废；残存城墙展示了这座边境城镇昔日防御工事的规模。

english: Esgueira lies beside the tidal waters near Aveiro. Its position fostered salt production and trade, and documents mention the maritime waters of Esgueira as early as 1050. Count Henry granted the settlement a charter in 1110, while the monastery of Lorvão held property here. Manuel I issued a new charter in 1515, and in 1533 Esgueira became the seat of a comarca. Salt remained an important part of its economy until the seventeenth century, when the coastal waters and their flats still shaped local livelihoods.
simp_chinese: 埃什盖拉坐落在阿威罗附近的潮汐水域旁。这里的位置有利于制盐和盐业贸易，早在 1050 年的文书中就已提及埃什盖拉的海水。恩里克伯爵于 1110 年授予聚落特许状，洛尔旺修道院也在此拥有产业。曼努埃尔一世于 1515 年颁发新特许状，1533 年埃什盖拉成为一个地区的驻地。盐业直到十七世纪仍是当地经济的重要部分，海水和潮滩深刻影响着居民的生计。

english: Esk'et, near Alkali Lake, lies in the plateau country of the Esk'etemc, a Secwépemc people. Their families moved between seasonal sites for fishing, hunting, and gathering, drawing on the lake and the neighboring Fraser River. In 1808 Simon Fraser traveled through their territory; the fur trade followed, bringing new goods and visitors to an established homeland.
simp_chinese: 埃斯克特位于阿尔卡利湖附近的高原，是塞克韦佩姆克人中埃斯克特马克一支的家园。各个家庭在季节性地点之间迁行，捕鱼、狩猎和采集，利用湖泊及邻近弗雷泽河的物产。1808年，西蒙·弗雷泽经过他们的土地；此后毛皮贸易带来了新的货物与访客。

english: Eskalapia is a Shawnee name preserved among the hills and hollows south of the Ohio River. A high ridge, a hollow and springs share the name in this dissected upland. The Salt Lick Creek branch of an old warrior trail passed through the area, linking the Ohio shore with routes across Kentucky. Eskalapia Mountain rises above the surrounding valleys, a landmark in a country traversed by Indigenous travelers long before European settlement.
simp_chinese: 埃斯卡拉皮亚是俄亥俄河以南丘陵与幽谷之间保留下来的肖尼语名称。在这片沟谷纵横的高地，一座山岭、一条谷地和几处泉水都使用这个名字。一条古老战士小径的盐舔溪支线穿过这里，将俄亥俄河岸与穿越肯塔基的路线连接起来。埃斯卡拉皮亚山高出周围河谷，早在欧洲人定居之前，原住民旅人便穿行于这片山地。

english:
Eskil, historically written Eskiil, gave its name to a broad district of central Anatolia between Aksaray and Konya. After the Ottoman conquest in the late fifteenth century, this country formed a kaza of Karaman province. Eskil town served as its centre until the third quarter of the sixteenth century. Under Selim II, the name Eskiil passed to the district centred on Karapınar, while the country around present-day Eskil continued as Esbkeşan.

The latter name was associated with the Atçeken Türkmen, known for raising horses and camels. Eighteenth-century petitions reveal the pressures on their villages. In September 1738, the local judge reported raids and thefts of belongings and livestock. A February 1749 petition complained of brigands around Sultanhanı and asked that pass guards stationed there return to their villages. Livestock, road security and access to the Ottoman courts thus appear together in the district's surviving history.
simp_chinese:
埃斯基尔在史料中写作Eskiil，这个名字曾指阿克萨赖与科尼亚之间的广大地区。十五世纪末奥斯曼征服中安纳托利亚后，当地成为卡拉曼省的县，埃斯基尔镇一直担任县治，直到十六世纪第三季度。塞利姆二世时期，以卡拉珀纳尔为中心的新县沿用Eskiil之名，今埃斯基尔周围则以Esbkeşan为县名延续。

后一个名称与擅长养马、养骆驼的阿特切肯土库曼人相连。十八世纪呈文反映村落承受的压力：1738年9月，地方法官报告村民财物和牲畜遭抢；1749年2月，居民又控诉苏丹驿附近盗匪，并要求驻守当地的关隘守卫返回原村。畜养、道路治安与向奥斯曼法庭申诉，交织在当地的历史中。

english: Eskimanetigon was an Indigenous name for the river now called the Spanish, which flows south to the North Channel of Lake Huron. Its mouth faces the islands of the Manitoulin country, used by Ojibwe communities of the northern shore as well as by the Odawa. In 1824 John McBean, a Hudson's Bay Company officer at the La Cloche trading post, recorded the river's name on a map. The river and its tributaries provided routes through the wooded country north of the lake.
simp_chinese: 埃斯基马内蒂贡是西班牙河的原住民名称。这条河向南流入休伦湖北部水道，河口与马尼图林群岛相对；奥达瓦人和北岸的奥吉布瓦社群都曾利用这些岛屿。1824年，拉克洛什贸易站的哈得孙湾公司职员约翰·麦克宾在地图上记下了河名。河流及其支流为穿越湖北森林地带提供了通路。

english:
Eskippakaithiki was a Shawnee village in the Kentucky country, near the place later called Indian Old Fields. It lay along the Warriors' Path, a route connecting the Ohio valley with lands to the south. Traders knew the settlement as Blue Lick Town, a name recalling the salt licks of the surrounding countryside.

The village appears in accounts and maps from the middle of the eighteenth century. A group of English traders returning from Cherokee country was robbed near it in 1753. Shawnee people may have established the settlement only a few years earlier and left it around 1754, when attacks by Catawba enemies threatened the community. A map published in 1755 placed it along the Warriors' Path. Later visitors remembered the fields and the village that had stood there.
simp_chinese:
埃斯基帕凯西基是肯塔基地区的一座肖尼村庄，靠近后来称为印第安旧田的地方。村庄位于战士小径沿线，这条路连接俄亥俄河谷与南方土地。商人称它为蓝舔镇，名称让人想起周围地区的盐舔地。

村庄见于十八世纪中叶的记述和地图。1753年，一队从切罗基地区返回的英国商人在附近遭到抢劫。肖尼人可能只在数年前建立了聚落，约于1754年因卡托巴敌人的袭击威胁而离开。1755年出版的一幅地图将它标在战士小径沿线。后来的来访者仍记得这里的田地和曾经存在的村庄。

english:
Esna lies on the western bank of the Nile south of Luxor. In antiquity it was known as Latopolis, and its temple was dedicated to Khnum, the ram-headed creator god. The temple was built over several centuries under Ptolemaic and Roman rulers, and its decorated hall stood amid the later town. The river town also became a market for caravans arriving from the south.

By the late eighteenth century caravans from Sennar assembled at Ibrim before travelling north to Esna, their principal market in Egypt. They brought gum arabic, senna and camels as well as enslaved people, who had been seized from communities beyond the sultanate. Merchants carried textiles and manufactured goods on the return journey, connecting the Nile Valley to the lands of Sudan.
simp_chinese:
埃斯纳位于卢克索以南的尼罗河西岸。古代这里称为拉托波利斯，神庙供奉公羊首的创造神克努姆。托勒密与罗马统治者历经数世纪修建神庙，其装饰华丽的大厅坐落在后来的城镇之中。这座河畔城镇后来也成为来自南方商队的市场。

到十八世纪末，来自森纳尔的商队在伊布里姆集结，然后北行至埃斯纳，这是他们在埃及的主要市场。商队带来阿拉伯胶、番泻叶和骆驼，也运送从苏丹国之外的社区掳来的被奴役者。商人在返程时携带纺织品和制成品，将尼罗河谷与苏丹地区连接起来。

english: Eso lies in Bingo, one of the eight ancient provinces that made up the San’yōdō. The circuit was established in the Asuka period (538–710) as part of the Gokishichidō, and Bingo was listed alongside Harima, Mimasaka, Bizen, Bitchū, Aki, Suō, and Nagato. The old administrative system faded by the Muromachi period (1333–1467), but the name San’yōdō also referred to the main road along the sunny southern side of Honshu’s central mountains, and that route remained important. The road ran mainly east–west. Its eastern terminus was Kyoto; from there it passed through Fushimi, Yodo, Yamazaki, and Hyōgo, then followed the Seto Inland Sea coast to Hagi near Shimonoseki. It played a strategic and logistical role in military movements. Emperor Go-Daigo in the fourteenth century and Toyotomi Hideyoshi in the sixteenth used it to flee conflict, return to the Kinai, or move troops. Under the Tokugawa shogunate, many daimyō travelled it for their mandatory sankin kotai journeys to Edo, while merchants, traveling entertainers, pilgrims, and other commoners also used the road. Traffic on the San’yōdō remained heavy through the Edo period (1603–later). The supplied material does not record separate town events for Eso; its historical setting is Bingo’s place within the San’yōdō system and the road’s continuing administrative, military, and everyday transport functions from the Muromachi through the Edo period.
simp_chinese:
惠苏位于备后国。备后是古代山阳道八国之一，与播磨、美作、备前、备中、安艺、周防、长门并列。山阳道在飞鸟时代（538—710）作为五畿七道的一部分建立，其名称既指古代行政区划，也指穿越本州中央山脉南侧、即“向阳”一侧的主干道路。到室町时代（1333—1467），旧有的道制逐渐消失，但这条道路的重要性并未随之消退。

 这条道路大体东西走向，东端在京都，向西经伏见、淀、山崎、兵库，沿濑户内海海岸延伸至下关附近的萩。它在军事和后勤上作用显著：十四世纪的后醍醐天皇、十六世纪的丰臣秀吉等人都曾利用山阳道逃离战乱、返回畿内或调动军队。德川幕府时期，许多大名沿此路前往江户参勤交代；道路也供商人、巡游艺人、朝圣者和其他平民通行。

 江户时代（1603—后来），山阳道仍保持繁忙交通。就现有材料而言，惠苏本身没有留下独立的城镇事件记载，其历史背景主要体现为备后在山阳道体系中的位置，以及这条道路在室町至江户时期持续承担的行政、军事与日常交通功能。

english: The coast around Puerto Espada lies on the eastern side of the Guajira peninsula, facing the Gulf of Venezuela. The peninsula is largely arid, with headlands and bays along the edge of the Caribbean. Across the gulf rises the Paraguaná peninsula; farther south the gulf narrows towards Lake Maracaibo. Wayuu communities maintained their presence across Guajira throughout the era of Spanish colonial expansion.
simp_chinese: 埃斯帕达港附近海岸位于瓜希拉半岛东侧，面对委内瑞拉湾。半岛大部分地区干旱，加勒比海沿岸分布着海角和海湾。海湾对面是帕拉瓜纳半岛，向南则逐渐收窄并通往马拉开波湖。在西班牙殖民扩张期间，瓦尤社群仍在瓜希拉各地保持自己的存在。

sources.title: Venezuela National Report to WATS I Pritchard 1984 w orig.pdf

english: Espakeh lies in the mountainous Lashar country of western Baluchistan, between the Bampur basin and the Makran coast. The settlement has an old fort, one of the fortified sites that marked this rugged inland landscape. The surrounding mountains divide the arid country into valleys and basins, while routes through them connect settlements of the interior with the coast. Medieval geographers described Makran as a sparsely populated region with few resources, though its valleys supported cultivated land where water was available.
simp_chinese: 埃斯帕凯位于俾路支斯坦西部的拉沙尔山区，介于班布尔盆地和马克兰海岸之间。当地有一座古堡，是这片崎岖内陆众多设防地点之一。周围山脉将干旱地区分隔成谷地和盆地，穿山道路则连接内陆聚落与海岸。中世纪地理学家称马克兰人烟稀少、物产有限，但有水的山谷仍能维持耕作。

english: Espe lies in the dry Tokrau basin north of Lake Balkhash. The Zhilanshchik-Espe is an intermittent watercourse that joins the Tokrau valley from the right, carrying water mainly during spring floods. Downstream, the Tokrau valley narrows through the Karatal gorge before widening again; its channel does not maintain a continuous flow across the dry country.
simp_chinese: 埃斯珀位于巴尔喀什湖北方干旱的托克劳河流域。日兰希克—埃斯珀是一条间歇性河流，从右侧汇入托克劳河谷，主要在春汛时带来水流。下游的托克劳河谷通过卡拉塔尔峡谷时变窄，随后再次展宽；河道穿过干旱地区，水流并不常年持续。

english: Off the southwestern coast of Jutland, the North Sea meets a chain of low islands and tidal flats. The North Frisian Islands shelter shallow waters where channels wind between sandbanks, marshes and small islets. Tides reshape the shore, exposing wide stretches of mud and sand before covering them again. Beyond the island chain the sea opens westward, exposed to North Sea winds and waves.
simp_chinese: 日德兰西南海岸外，北海与一列低矮岛屿和潮滩相接。北弗里西亚群岛庇护着浅水区，水道在沙洲、沼泽和小岛之间蜿蜒。潮汐不断塑造海岸，大片泥沙滩时而露出、时而被海水覆盖。岛链之外，海面向西敞开，承受北海风浪。

english: Esperance Bay lies on the southern coast of Western Australia, sheltered in part by islands of the Recherche Archipelago. In 1792 the French expedition searching for La Pérouse anchored in these waters; the bay took its European name from one of the expedition’s ships, Espérance. Rocky islands and reefs lie beyond the bay towards the open Southern Ocean.
simp_chinese: 埃斯佩兰斯湾位于西澳大利亚南岸，勒谢什群岛部分岛屿为海湾提供庇护。1792年，搜寻拉佩鲁兹的法国远征队在这片水域停泊；海湾的欧洲名称来自远征队船只“希望”号。岩石岛屿与礁石分布在海湾之外，面向开阔的南大洋。

english:
Espiel belonged to the hill country north of Córdoba, where local government developed within the larger jurisdictional world of that city. Its early modern institutions are documented more securely than an uninterrupted narrative from antiquity. Under Charles I and Queen Juana, royal authorisation allowed the council to have its own alcaldes and chief alguacil, giving the community a recognisable body of local officers.

A municipal grain store, or pósito, was created under Philip II. Its surviving ordinances dated 1593 show how provisioning and the management of grain formed part of town government. The seventeenth century also brought a period of private lordship, when Espiel passed to Juan de Góngora, the first marquis of Almodóvar. This arrangement proved temporary. The history of the locality through the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries therefore involved negotiation between municipal institutions, Córdoba's superior jurisdiction and the claims of private lords, rather than a simple progression toward complete urban independence.
simp_chinese:
埃斯彼尔位于科尔多瓦以北的山区，地方政府在科尔多瓦较大的司法辖区体系内发展。相比从古代连续讲述的历史，其近世机构有更明确的文献依据。在卡洛斯一世与胡安娜女王统治下，王室授权议会设置本地行政司法长官及总执达官，使社群拥有清楚可辨的地方官员体系。

腓力二世时期设立市镇粮仓，即波西托。留存的1593年条例反映了粮食供应与管理也是地方政府职责的一部分。17世纪，埃斯彼尔一度转为私人领地，归属首任阿尔莫多瓦侯爵胡安·德·贡戈拉，但这一安排并未持久。此后18世纪至19世纪初，当地历史涉及市镇机构、科尔多瓦上级司法权与私人领主要求之间的协商，不能简单写成不断走向完全城市独立的过程。

english: Below the great bend of the Rio Grande, the river enters a succession of deep limestone gorges known as the Lower Canyons. Sanderson Canyon joins the river from the north, cutting through the dry uplands of the northern Chihuahuan Desert. Springs add water to the Rio Grande along this confined reach, where steep walls rise above a narrow channel and desert shrubs grow on the slopes.
simp_chinese: 格兰德河流过大弯曲地区后，进入一连串深邃的石灰岩峡谷，称为下峡谷。桑德森峡谷从北侧切过奇瓦瓦沙漠北部干燥的高地，通向大河。泉水在这段狭窄河道沿途为格兰德河补给水流，陡壁耸立在河上，沙漠灌木生长于山坡。

english:
Esquatak, remembered as the fireplace of the Mohican nation, was a principal village and council place near the Hudson River. Mohican communities occupied both banks of the river and lands extending eastward into the Housatonic River valley. The river that they called Mahicannituck carried their canoes and connected their villages long before the arrival of Dutch traders.

After Henry Hudson's voyage upriver in 1609, Dutch merchants came seeking furs and established Fort Orange in 1624. Rivalry over trade contributed to war between the Mohican and Mohawk. By 1629 the Mohawk had taken former Mohican territory west of the Hudson, and many Mohicans moved east. Dutch tenants established farms in the Esquatak area from 1630, bringing further change to the homeland around the council fire.
simp_chinese:
埃斯夸塔克被称作莫希干民族的炉火所在，是哈得孙河附近的一座主要村庄和议事之地。莫希干社群居住在河流两岸，领地向东延伸至豪萨托尼克河谷。在荷兰商人到来之前，他们称为马希坎尼塔克的河流已供独木舟通行，连接各处村庄。

1609年亨利·哈得孙溯河航行后，荷兰商人前来寻求毛皮，并于1624年建立奥兰治堡。贸易竞争促成了莫希干人与莫霍克人之间的战争。到1629年，莫霍克人已占据哈得孙河西岸原属莫希干人的土地，许多莫希干人向东迁移。1630年起，荷兰佃户在埃斯夸塔克地区建立农场，议事炉火周围的故土继续发生变化。

english: Esquegua was the name recorded in early Spanish accounts for an Indigenous chief and his territory in the uplands of central Panama. Its country lay in steep mountains near the later town of Chitra, apart from the lowland chiefdom of Parita. Routes through Esquegua's and neighbouring Urraca lands crossed difficult hill country, which the chronicler Oviedo described as a hard way across the isthmus. In the early sixteenth-century conquest, Spanish parties sent into the territory met determined resistance. Captains returned from these expeditions after attacks by stones and missiles thrown from above, without having subdued the country.
simp_chinese: 埃斯克瓜是早期西班牙记述中一位原住民首领及其山地领地的名称，位于巴拿马中部。其领地在陡峭的山地之中，靠近后来的奇特拉镇，与低地的帕里塔酋邦各不相同。穿越埃斯克瓜与邻近乌拉卡领地的道路经过险峻山岭，编年史家奥维耶多认为那是一条艰难的跨地峡路线。十六世纪初征服期间，进入该领地的西班牙队伍遭遇顽强抵抗，队长们常在从高处投下的石块和投掷物攻击后撤回，未能平定此地。

english: The Esquiman Channel is a deep branch of the Laurentian Channel, extending northeast through the Gulf of St. Lawrence towards the Strait of Belle Isle. Beyond it, cold water enters from the Labrador Shelf through the narrower strait. Sea ice and fog make the passage between Labrador and Newfoundland difficult, but its waters drew Basque whalers in the sixteenth century. Their ships arrived after the ice cleared and sailed away before winter closed the coast again.
simp_chinese: 埃斯基曼水道是劳伦森海槽的一条深水支流，向东北穿过圣劳伦斯湾，伸向贝尔岛海峡。较冷的拉布拉多陆架海水经狭窄海峡流入湾内。海冰和浓雾使拉布拉多与纽芬兰之间的通道难以航行，但十六世纪巴斯克捕鲸人仍来到这些水域。他们待冰消后驶入，冬季再次封住海岸前离去。

english: The Ess is a right-bank tributary of the Konda in the forests of western Siberia. It winds through the northern part of the Konda basin, a landscape of coniferous woodland, peat bogs and small lakes. The Konda carries its waters onward to the Irtysh. Spring snowmelt raises the rivers after the long winter freeze, spreading water across the low valley floor.
simp_chinese: 埃斯河是西西伯利亚森林中孔达河的一条右岸支流。它曲折流经孔达流域北部，周围针叶林、泥炭沼泽和小湖交错；孔达河再将其河水带往额尔齐斯河。漫长冬季冰封之后，春季融雪使河水上涨，水漫过低平谷底。

english:
Essen grew around an imperial foundation governed by a prince-abbess. Its church and the adjoining town developed a close but often contested relationship: the abbess claimed authority over both the territory and the appointment of parish clergy, while the town council sought a greater voice in the conduct of its own affairs.

The Reformation sharpened this dispute. In 1560 townspeople sang German hymns in the church despite the opposition of the abbess. The council invited the preacher Heinrich Barenbroich, and in 1563 introduced Protestant worship at the market church. The abbess challenged the city's actions before the imperial court. The town embraced the Reformation while the religious foundation remained Catholic, leaving neighbouring churches to serve different confessions within the same small imperial territory.
simp_chinese:
埃森围绕一座由女修院长亲王治理的帝国教会领地发展起来。修院教堂与邻近城镇关系密切，却也常有争执：女院长主张对领地和教区神职任命的权力，市议会则力求在自身事务中拥有更大声音。

宗教改革加剧了这场争端。1560年，市民不顾女院长反对，在教堂唱起德语圣歌。议会邀请传教士海因里希·巴伦布罗赫，并于1563年在市场教堂推行新教礼拜。女院长向帝国法院控告城镇的举措。埃森城接受宗教改革，修院则仍信奉天主教；在这片小小的帝国领地内，毗邻的教堂因此分别服务于不同教派。

english:
The Essequibo is one of the great rivers of the Guianas, flowing north from the forested interior to a broad Atlantic estuary. Dutch traders established a foothold in its basin during the early seventeenth century. Fort Kyk-Over-Al stood on a small island at the meeting of the Essequibo with the Cuyuni and Mazaruni, commanding routes into the interior and the trading networks along those rivers.

The Dutch colony grew around trade and plantations. In the eighteenth century its centre moved downriver to Flag Island, where the brick Fort Zeelandia replaced an earlier wooden defence. By 1748 Kyk-Over-Al had been abandoned as the seat of government. Plantation expansion depended on the labour of enslaved Africans, while the rivers remained routes between the coast and Indigenous communities inland.
simp_chinese:
埃塞奎博河是圭亚那地区的大河之一，自森林内陆向北流入宽阔的大西洋河口。十七世纪初，荷兰商人在流域建立据点。基克奥弗阿尔堡坐落在埃塞奎博河与库尤尼河、马扎鲁尼河交汇处的小岛上，控制通往内陆的水路及沿河贸易网络。

荷兰殖民地围绕贸易和种植园发展。十八世纪，行政中心移至下游的旗岛，砖造泽兰迪亚堡取代了早期木造防御设施。到1748年，基克奥弗阿尔堡已不再是政府所在地。种植园扩张依靠被奴役的非洲人劳动，河流仍是连接海岸与内陆原住民社群的道路。

english: The forests of the Essequibo basin cover much of the Guiana interior. The great river flows north towards the Atlantic, receiving tributaries such as the Potaro, Cuyuni and Mazaruni along its course. Rapids and falls interrupt the waterways, while dense tropical forest covers the land between them. These rivers link the interior to the broad Essequibo estuary, but the broken channels make passage upstream a demanding journey.
simp_chinese: 埃塞奎博河流域的森林覆盖圭亚那内陆大片地区。大河向北流往大西洋，途中接纳波塔罗河、库尤尼河和马扎鲁尼河等支流。急流与瀑布截断水道，河流之间则覆盖着茂密热带森林。这些河流将内陆接向宽阔的埃塞奎博河口，但水道的险阻使逆流而上成为艰难旅程。

english: The Essequibo opens into a broad Atlantic estuary on the Guiana coast. Islands divide the lower river into channels before its waters meet the sea. Dutch settlement in the basin grew around river forts, and in the eighteenth century Fort Zeelandia on Flag Island became the colonial centre. Mudbanks and mangrove-fringed shores are features of this low coast, where currents carry sediment northwest along the Guianas.
simp_chinese: 埃塞奎博河在圭亚那海岸形成宽阔河口，注入大西洋。下游的岛屿将河流分成多条水道，河水在此与海洋相接。荷兰殖民聚落围绕流域中的河堡发展，十八世纪旗岛上的泽兰迪亚堡成为殖民中心。泥滩和红树林岸线是这片低平海岸的特色，海流沿圭亚那海岸向西北输送泥沙。

english: Essipit, the “river of shells” in Innu-aimun, flows through Innu country to the north shore of the St. Lawrence. Its mouth lies northeast of Tadoussac, where the Saguenay enters the great river. The neighbouring place was already marked on a European map in 1601 as Escanimes, a name associated with the wild berries found there. In 1603 Innu, Algonquin and Etchemin leaders met the French at Tadoussac, establishing an alliance that shaped relations in the St. Lawrence valley.
simp_chinese: 埃西皮在因努语中意为“贝壳之河”，穿过因努人的土地，流向圣劳伦斯河北岸。河口位于萨格奈河汇入圣劳伦斯河的塔杜萨克东北方。1601年的欧洲地图已将附近地方标作埃斯卡尼姆斯，这个名字与当地的野生浆果有关。1603年，因努、阿尔冈昆和埃奇明领袖在塔杜萨克会见法国人，建立了影响圣劳伦斯河谷历史的盟约。

english: Cap Est projects from Madagascar's northeastern coast into the Indian Ocean. Its headland and neighbouring bays stand north of the Masoala peninsula, on a shore visited by ships travelling through the western ocean. In 1786 the adventurer Maurice Benyowsky established himself in this region after earlier ventures on Madagascar. A French force sent against him reached the bay at Cap Est, and Benyowsky was killed in the fighting that followed.
simp_chinese: 埃斯特角从马达加斯加东北海岸伸入印度洋。岬角与附近海湾位于马苏阿拉半岛以北，穿行大洋西部的船只曾到访这段海岸。1786年，冒险家莫里斯·贝尼奥夫斯基在马达加斯加早期的事业之后来到这一地区。法国派出的部队抵达埃斯特角海湾，贝尼奥夫斯基在随后的战斗中丧生。

english: Estatoe was a Cherokee town on the Tugaloo River, one of the Lower Towns in the valleys of the Savannah's upper tributaries. Paths linked it with nearby Tugaloo and other settlements beyond the mountain ridges. In the eighteenth century the towns became involved in trade and the shifting alliances of the colonial frontier. Repeated warfare took a heavy toll, and by the time James Adair published his history in 1775 he described Estatoe and Tugaloo as abandoned or destroyed.
simp_chinese: 埃斯塔托是图加卢河畔的一座切罗基村镇，属于萨凡纳河上游支流谷地的下游城镇群。道路将它与附近的图加卢以及山脊之外的其他聚落连接起来。十八世纪，这些村镇卷入殖民边疆的贸易与不断变化的联盟。反复战争造成严重破坏，到詹姆斯·阿代尔1775年出版历史著作时，他记载埃斯塔托和图加卢均已荒废或毁坏。

english:
Este stands at the foot of the Euganean Hills southwest of Padua. Ancient Ateste was a major centre of the Veneti, whose inscriptions survive on funerary and votive objects. The Roman colony settled veterans here after the battle of Actium. In the Middle Ages the castle here gave its name to the House of Este, later rulers of Ferrara and Modena.

Ezzelino da Romano twice conquered the town in the thirteenth century. The Scaligeri, Carraresi and Visconti contested Este during the fourteenth century. In 1405 the town submitted to Venice, beginning a long period under the republic. Its economy grew, though the plague of 1630 interrupted that prosperity. After Venice fell in 1797 and the Napoleonic wars reshaped northern Italy, Este passed under Austrian rule.
simp_chinese:
埃斯特坐落在帕多瓦西南的尤加尼山麓。古代阿泰斯特是威尼提人的重要中心，墓葬和供奉器物上保存着他们的铭文。罗马人在阿克提乌姆战役后于此安置退伍士兵。中世纪时，当地城堡赋予埃斯特家族以名称，该家族后来统治费拉拉和摩德纳。

十三世纪，埃泽利诺·达罗马诺两次征服此城。十四世纪，斯卡利杰里、卡拉雷西和维斯孔蒂家族争夺埃斯特。1405年，城镇归顺威尼斯，开始了共和国的长期统治。当地经济得到发展，但1630年的瘟疫打断了繁荣。1797年威尼斯覆灭，拿破仑战争重塑意大利北部后，埃斯特转归奥地利统治。

english: Punta del Este projects into the waters at the outer Río de la Plata, where the broad estuary meets the Atlantic. In 1516 Juan Díaz de Solís reached this coast and passed the island of Lobos, named for its sea lions. His expedition found anchorage in Maldonado Bay and claimed the harbour for the Spanish Crown before venturing farther into the great estuary.
simp_chinese: 埃斯特角伸入拉普拉塔河外缘的水域，宽阔河口在此与大西洋相接。1516年，胡安·迪亚斯·德·索利斯抵达这片海岸，经过因海狮得名的洛沃斯岛。他的船队在马尔多纳多湾找到泊地，为西班牙王室占有港湾，随后继续驶入宽阔河口。

english: Estella's medieval setting was the Kingdom of Navarre, a Pyrenean realm that had once stretched across both sides of the western mountains. By the 14th century its native royal line had ended in 1234 and its rulers were tied by marriage to French dynasties, while the kingdom still defended its own laws and institutions. The chancery and court used Navarro-Aragonese officially from 1329, and the older pilgrim route through Navarre had already brought Franks, crafts and Romance speech into Navarrese towns. Navarre's political weight had been reduced earlier, after the loss of the western Basque districts to Castile in 1200 left it landlocked. At the opening of the period, Estella therefore belonged to a small but legally distinct kingdom rather than to Castile. In 1512 Ferdinand the Catholic invaded Navarre; Queen Catherine and King John III withdrew north of the Pyrenees, and south of the mountains Navarre was annexed to the Crown of Castile in 1515 while keeping an ambiguous separate status. The kingdom retained home rule and a Diputación, but tensions with the Spanish government sharpened in 1794 when Manuel Godoy tried to suppress Navarrese and Basque self-government. Estella itself had been founded in 1090 by King Sancho Ramírez on the pilgrim road to Santiago de Compostela, and its streets filled with Frankish merchants and craftsmen.
simp_chinese: 埃斯特利亚的中世纪背景是纳瓦拉王国，这个比利牛斯王国曾跨越西部山地两侧。到14世纪，其本土王统已于1234年断绝，君主通过婚姻与法国王朝相连，但王国仍维护自己的法律与制度。自1329年起，纳瓦拉-阿拉贡语在宫廷和皇家行政中取得官方地位；此前经过纳瓦拉的朝圣之路已把“法兰克人”、手工艺和罗曼语带入纳瓦拉城镇。更早的1200年，纳瓦拉把西部巴斯克地区输给卡斯蒂利亚，因而成为内陆王国。在这一时期开始时，埃斯特利亚因此属于一个小而法律地位独特的王国，而非卡斯蒂利亚。1512年，天主教徒斐迪南入侵纳瓦拉；卡塔琳娜女王和约翰三世退往比利牛斯山以北，山南的纳瓦拉于1515年并入卡斯蒂利亚王室，却保留含糊的单独地位。王国保有自治政府（Diputación），但同西班牙政府的紧张在1794年加剧，当时曼努埃尔·戈多伊试图彻底压制纳瓦拉和巴斯克自治。埃斯特利亚本身由国王桑乔·拉米雷斯于1090年建在通往圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉的朝圣之路上，街巷里聚集着法兰克商人和工匠。

english: Esteriktyaax lies east of a great bend of the Indigirka, near the site of Zashiversk. Founded in 1639 as a Russian fort, Zashiversk became an administrative centre on the river; its wooden Church of the Saviour was built in 1700.
simp_chinese: 埃斯特里克塔赫位于因迪吉尔卡河一处大弯道以东，靠近扎希韦尔斯克旧址。扎希韦尔斯克于1639年作为俄国堡寨建立，后来成为河畔的行政中心；城中的木造救世主教堂建于1700年。

english: Esto’k Gna is the name used by the Carrizo/Comecrudo people, whose homeland lies along the lower Rio Grande and its delta. The river flows through thorny brush and coastal wetlands to the Gulf of Mexico; its banks and channels have long been places of residence and ceremony. Spanish colonizers used names including Carrizo and Comecrudo for Indigenous people of the region. Missions and forced labour sought to remove communities from their lands and traditions, but their descendants continue to remember their connection to this country.
simp_chinese: 埃斯托克纳是卡里索／科梅克鲁多人使用的名称，其故土位于格兰德河下游与三角洲。河流穿过荆棘灌丛和沿海湿地，流入墨西哥湾；河岸与水道长期是居住和举行仪式的地方。西班牙殖民者以卡里索、科梅克鲁多等名称称呼这一地区的原住民。传教区和强迫劳动试图使社区脱离土地与传统，但后代仍记得与这片故土的联系。

english: Estremoz commands a strategic position in the Alentejo between Portugal and Castile. After passing between Christian and Muslim rulers, it received a charter from Afonso III in 1258. King Denis rebuilt the castle as a royal residence, and his widow Elizabeth died there in 1336 after helping mediate peace between Portugal and Castile. During the succession crisis of 1383–1385, Nuno Álvares Pereira made Estremoz his headquarters before defeating Castilian forces at Atoleiros. Its military importance endured: during the Portuguese Restoration War, armies fighting nearby won the battles of Ameixial in 1663 and Montes Claros in 1665.
simp_chinese: 埃什特雷莫什位于阿连特茹，扼守葡萄牙与卡斯蒂利亚之间的战略要地。此地曾在基督教与穆斯林统治者之间易手，1258 年获得阿方索三世的特许状。迪尼什国王将城堡改建为王室居所；其遗孀伊莎贝尔在调解葡萄牙与卡斯蒂利亚和平后，于 1336 年逝世于此。1383—1385 年继承危机期间，努诺·阿尔瓦雷什·佩雷拉以埃什特雷莫什为驻地，随后在阿托莱鲁什击败卡斯蒂利亚军队。这里的军事价值历久不衰：葡萄牙复国战争中，葡军在附近赢得 1663 年阿梅希亚尔战役和 1665 年蒙特什克拉鲁什战役。

english: Eswawpuddenah, the “dividing river,” is a name for the Broad River of the Carolinas, which marked a boundary between Cherokee and Catawba lands. Rising in the Blue Ridge, the river flows south and east through the foothills before joining the Saluda to form the Congaree. Colonial settlers called it the English Broad River to distinguish it from the French Broad, which rises in the same mountain country but flows northwest.
simp_chinese: 埃斯瓦普德纳意为“分界之河”，是卡罗来纳布罗德河的一个名称。这条河曾是切罗基人与卡托巴人土地之间的界线。它发源于蓝岭山脉，向东南穿过山麓，与萨卢达河汇合形成康加里河。殖民者称其为英属布罗德河，以区别同样发源于这片山地、却向西北流去的法属布罗德河。

english:
Esztergom stands on the right bank of the Danube at the bend where the river leaves the hills for the plain, under a castle hill that was the first capital of the kingdom and the seat of Hungary's primate. Its archbishops were the first churchmen of the realm, and in the fifteenth century, especially under Archbishop János Vitéz, the court on the hill drew royal guests, scholars and artists from across Europe. Tamás Bakócz, who held the see until 1521, had Italian architects build the Bakócz Chapel in 1507, the earliest important Renaissance building to survive in Hungary.

After Mohács in 1526, where the archbishop died, Esztergom was besieged six times in seventeen years as Ferdinand I and Zápolya fought for the crown. Ferdinand took the castle in 1530 and sent the chapter and archive to Nagyszombat and Pozsony. In 1543 Suleiman the Magnificent captured it, and as Estergon it became the seat of an Ottoman sanjak on the northwestern border, shielding the mining towns of the highlands, Vienna and Buda. The poet Bálint Balassa died in the siege of 1594, and a force under Mansfeld retook the castle in 1595, but the Ottomans regained it in 1605. John III Sobieski finally freed the town in 1683. Crafts and winemaking revived in the eighteenth century; in 1761 the archbishop recovered the castle hill; in 1820 the see returned to a town that planned a new basilica.
simp_chinese:
埃斯泰尔戈姆位于多瑙河右岸，河水在这里出山丘入平原，城堡山是王国的第一座都城，也是匈牙利首席主教的驻地。大主教是王国的头号教会人物，十五世纪，尤其是在大主教维泰兹·亚诺什任内，山上的宫廷吸引了来自欧洲各地的王室宾客、学者和艺术家。执掌教区至1521年的巴科奇·塔马什，于1507年请意大利建筑师建起巴科奇礼拜堂，这是匈牙利保存至今最早、最重要的文艺复兴建筑。

1526年莫哈奇战役中大主教战死，此后十七年里，斐迪南一世与萨波尧伊争夺王位，埃斯泰尔戈姆被围攻六次。斐迪南于1530年占领城堡，并把教士会和档案送往纳吉松堡和波若尼。1543年苏莱曼大帝攻占此城，它作为埃斯泰尔贡成为奥斯曼的一个桑贾克治所，位于西北边境，守护着高地矿业城镇、维也纳和布达。诗人巴拉沙·巴林特死于1594年的围城，曼斯费尔德率军1595年收复城堡，但奥斯曼人1605年又夺回。1683年波兰国王约翰·索别斯基最终解放了该城。十八世纪，手工业和酿酒业复兴，1761年大主教收回城堡山；1820年教区迁回这座计划建造新大教堂的城镇。

english: Étain lies in the Woëvre plain east of Verdun. Its medieval walls enclosed a town with four gates, a church dedicated to Saint Martin and a market that drew cloth merchants to an important fair in 1409. The defences were strengthened in 1629, but the town was ravaged in 1635 during the wars of the seventeenth century. Étain was also the seat of a provost and later a bailiwick.
simp_chinese: 埃坦位于凡尔登以东的沃埃夫尔平原。中世纪城墙环绕着这座拥有四座城门和圣马丁教堂的城镇；1409年，重要的集市吸引了布商前来。城防于1629年得到加固，但埃坦仍在十七世纪的战争中于1635年遭到破坏。此地还是一处领区及后来司法辖区的治所。

english: South of Paris, Étampes grew around a royal residence and the fortress whose surviving keep is known as the Tour de Guinette. Its distinctive four-lobed outline rises above the town and recalls the power of the Capetian kings in the region. During the Fronde, Étampes became a battleground: in 1652 royal troops besieged forces of the Prince of Condé in the town, leaving it badly damaged.
simp_chinese: 埃唐普位于巴黎以南，围绕王室居所和城堡发展起来。城堡幸存的主塔被称为吉内特塔，独特的四瓣形轮廓高出城镇，令人想起卡佩王朝在这一地区的权势。投石党战争期间，埃唐普成为战场：1652年，王军围攻城内的孔代亲王部队，城镇遭到严重破坏。

english:
Etawah stands on the Yamuna near the country where it meets the Chambal. The surrounding region once formed part of ancient Panchala, and local traditions connect nearby Chakarnagar with the Mahabharata. In the centuries after the Ghurid conquest of northern India, Rajput clans settled across the district while the rulers of Delhi and Gwalior sought authority over it.

In 1400–1401 Mallu Iqbal Khan marched into the region and defeated Rai Sumar Singh of Etawah and other local landholders near the Kali Nadi. During Akbar's reign the district was granted as a jagir to Bahadur Khan. Much later, in 1801, the Nawab of Awadh ceded Etawah and other territories of the lower Doab to the British, though disputes with local landholders continued into the following years.
simp_chinese:
埃塔瓦位于亚穆纳河畔，靠近它与昌巴尔河交汇的地区。周围土地古时曾属于般遮罗，地方传说又将附近的查卡尔讷格尔与《摩诃婆罗多》联系起来。古尔人征服北印度后的数个世纪里，拉杰普特家族在这一带定居，德里和瓜廖尔的统治者也争取对当地的控制。

1400至1401年，马卢·伊克巴尔汗进军此地，在卡利河附近击败埃塔瓦的拉伊·苏马尔·辛格及其他地方地主。阿克巴在位时，这片地区作为采邑授予巴哈杜尔汗。许久之后，1801年阿瓦德纳瓦布将埃塔瓦及下河间地的其他领土割让给英国，但此后数年与地方地主的争端仍在继续。

english:
Etchemins lies within the wider Quebec country of northeastern North America, a region whose name is associated with the narrowing of the Saint Lawrence and with Algonquin speech. In the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries this country formed part of the French colony of Canada, the leading area of French colonial development in New France. The Saint Lawrence and its tributaries linked settlements, missions, and trade routes across the northeastern interior, while the Roman Catholic Church took a central place in colonial society from the foundation of Quebec City in 1608.

French rule continued until the Seven Years’ War. Between 1534 and 1763 the colony of Canada grew within New France; after the war, Canada passed to Britain. The region was reorganized first as the Province of Quebec from 1763 to 1791, then as Lower Canada from 1791. These imperial changes did not erase the French-speaking and Catholic character of the colony. Instead, they set the political and religious framework within which later Quebec history unfolded, as the old St. Lawrence settlements and their hinterlands were incorporated into a British colonial order.
simp_chinese:
埃切明位于北美洲东北部更广阔的魁北克地域之内，这一名称与圣劳伦斯河的收窄处及阿尔冈昆语有关。在16至17世纪，这片地域属于法国的加拿大殖民地，是新法兰西中法国殖民开发最领先的地区。圣劳伦斯河及其支流把聚落、传教站和贸易路线联系起来，贯穿东北内陆；而自1608年魁北克城建立以来，天主教会一直在殖民地社会中占据核心地位。

法国统治延续到七年战争之后。1534年至1763年间，加拿大殖民地在新法兰西内部发展；战争之后，加拿大转归英国。该地域先被组织为1763年至1791年的魁北克省，后成为1791年起的下加拿大。这些帝国层面的变化并未抹去殖民地的法语与天主教特征，而是为后来魁北克历史的展开设定了政治与宗教框架，使圣劳伦斯河旧聚落及其腹地逐步纳入英国殖民秩序。

english: Ethapetha was a name for Raccoon Creek, which flows south through the wooded hills of southeastern Ohio to the Ohio River. Its headwaters gather near New Plymouth, and its winding course passes through a broad watershed before reaching the larger river. In 1805 Samuel Holcomb settled beside the creek at the place where he later laid out the village of Vinton.
simp_chinese: 埃塔佩塔是浣熊溪的一个名称。这条溪流向南穿过俄亥俄东南部林木覆盖的丘陵，汇入俄亥俄河。源头在新普利茅斯附近汇合，蜿蜒水道流经广阔的流域，最终抵达大河。1805年，塞缪尔·霍尔科姆在溪边定居，后来在此规划了文顿村。

english:
Etharita was a principal village of the Tionontate, the people known to the French as the Petun for the tobacco they cultivated. Their villages stood along the high ground south of Georgian Bay, near their Wendat neighbours. Etharita housed the Jesuit mission of Saint-Jean and became a refuge for Wendat people fleeing attacks on their own communities in the region.

In December 1649 Haudenosaunee warriors attacked the village while many of its defenders were away. Etharita was plundered and burned, and the Jesuit missionary Charles Garnier was killed in the attack. The destruction formed part of a wider upheaval that scattered the Tionontate and Wendat from their homelands. Archaeologists have identified the Kelly-Campbell site with the village remembered in the Jesuit accounts.
simp_chinese:
埃塔里塔是蒂奥农塔特人的主要村庄。法国人因他们种植烟草而称他们为佩顿人；他们的村落位于乔治亚湾以南的高地，靠近温达特人的土地。埃塔里塔设有耶稣会圣让传教所，也接纳了逃避本地战火的温达特人。

1649年12月，许多守卫离村之际，豪德诺索尼战士袭击了埃塔里塔。村庄遭到劫掠焚毁，传教士夏尔·加尼耶遇害。这场破坏是更广泛动荡的一部分，蒂奥农塔特人与温达特人因此离散，离开了家园。考古学家将凯利-坎贝尔遗址认作耶稣会记载中的这座村庄。

english:
eThekwini lies on a sheltered bay of the Indian Ocean, with the Umgeni River entering the sea to its north. The bay, known to European sailors as Port Natal, offered a harbour on a coast where safe landing places were valuable. Its shores were inhabited long before a permanent European trading settlement appeared.

In 1686 the Dutch ship Stavenisse was wrecked farther down the coast, and survivors reached the bay. A Dutch East India Company vessel later collected them and claimed to have purchased the bay from local leaders, a transaction whose meaning was contested. In 1824 traders including Henry Fynn and Francis Farewell established a post and developed relations with the Zulu king Shaka. They traded in ivory, hides, cattle and grain. In 1835 the settlement was named Durban after the Cape governor Benjamin d'Urban.
simp_chinese:
埃特克维尼位于印度洋一处有遮蔽的海湾，乌姆盖尼河在其北面入海。欧洲水手称这里为纳塔尔港；在缺少安全登陆地点的海岸上，这片海湾提供了一处港湾。永久性的欧洲商站出现之前，湾岸早已有居民生活。

1686年，荷兰船只斯塔弗尼斯号在更南方的海岸失事，幸存者抵达海湾。后来荷兰东印度公司派船接走他们，并声称从当地首领手中购买了海湾；这场交易的含义存在争议。1824年，亨利·芬恩、弗朗西斯·法雷尔等商人在此建立商站，与祖鲁国王沙卡建立关系。他们交易象牙、兽皮、牛和谷物。1835年，聚落以开普总督本杰明·德班的名字命名为德班。

sources.title: john e. flint the cambridge history of africa vbook4you.pdf

english: South of Lake Tana, the highlands of Gojjam rise toward the Choqa massif. Streams descending from Mount Amedamit, one of its peaks, join to form the Birr, a tributary of the Abay. The volcanic mountains help divide the drainage of the lake basin from that of the surrounding highlands.
simp_chinese: 塔纳湖以南，戈贾姆高地向乔卡山地抬升。从其中一座山峰阿梅达米特流下的溪流汇合成比尔河，最终注入阿巴伊河。这片火山山地也是湖盆与周围高地的分水岭之一。

english:
The Etiwan lived near the junction of the Wando and Cooper rivers, in the country around Charleston harbour. English settlers recorded their communities on an island and along the river, and later near Goose Creek. Like other coastal peoples, they faced raids by the Westo as well as the growing demands of the new colony.

At the beginning of the Yamasee War in 1715, Etiwan fighters helped defend Port Royal for South Carolina, but later that year they joined the colony's opponents. By 1724 their people were dispersed among several parishes. Some asked the colonial assembly for land where they could come together, and it granted a tract west of Wassamasaw Swamp. Governor Glen still described the Etiwan as allies of the English government in 1751.
simp_chinese:
埃蒂万人居住在旺多河与库珀河汇合处附近，即查尔斯顿港周围的地区。英国移民记载了他们在岛上及沿河的聚落，后来又在古斯溪附近发现他们。与其他沿海民族一样，他们既面临韦斯托人的袭击，也承受新殖民地不断增长的要求。

1715年亚马西战争刚爆发时，埃蒂万战士协助南卡罗来纳保卫皇家港；当年晚些时候，他们转而加入反对殖民地的一方。到1724年，他们已散居于数个教区。一些人请求殖民地议会给予土地，以便重新聚居；议会在瓦萨马索沼泽以西拨出了一片土地。1751年，格伦总督仍将埃蒂万人列为英国政府的盟友。

english: Etnemitane belongs to the Takelma country of southwestern Oregon, and the available historical account describes the life of that wider people. Their villages gathered around the Rogue River, whose salmon supported a seasonal economy of fishing, hunting and gathering. Men caught fish with nets and spears, while women cleaned and dried the catch for storage. Preparation during spring, summer and early autumn supplied food for winter, making preservation as necessary as the harvest itself. Deer, elk, beaver and bear supplemented fish, and small mammals could be trapped by either men or women. Plant foods supplied nutrients that meat and fish could not provide in sufficient amounts. Acorns from Oregon white oak and California black oak, together with camas bulbs, were especially important; women also gathered seeds, roots and fruit. The Takelma cultivated native tobacco, their only recorded crop, and lived in small bands of related men and their families. The surrounding mountains delayed Euroamerican settlement until the nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 埃特内米塔内属于俄勒冈西南部塔克尔马人的地域，现有史料主要描述这一族群的共同生活。村落围绕罗格河分布，鲑鱼支撑着捕鱼、狩猎和采集相结合的季节经济。男子用网和矛捕鱼，女子清理并晾干鱼获；春、夏与初秋的采集和储藏为冬季准备食物，保存劳动与捕获本身同样重要。鹿、麋鹿、河狸和熊补充鱼食，男女也都能捕捉小型兽类。植物提供肉鱼难以充分供应的养分，其中俄勒冈白橡与加州黑橡的橡实，以及卡马斯球茎尤其重要；妇女还采集草籽、根与果实。塔克尔马人唯一有记载的栽培作物是本土烟草，通常以有亲属关系的男子及其家庭组成小群体。环绕山地延缓了欧美移民进入，直到十九世纪才有变化。

english: Etoho was an early name for the North Oconee River, which runs through the wooded uplands of Georgia. Farther downstream the Oconee joins the Ocmulgee to form the Altamaha, carrying their waters to the Atlantic. In the late eighteenth century settlers established a Baptist congregation called Etoho near the shoals of the upper river. The river valley formed part of a much older Native landscape of paths and settlements.
simp_chinese: 埃托霍是北奥科尼河的早期名称，这条河流经佐治亚林木茂密的高地。更远的下游，奥科尼河与奥克马尔吉河汇合形成阿尔塔马哈河，河水最终流向大西洋。十八世纪末，定居者在上游的浅滩附近建立一个名为埃托霍的浸信会教众。河谷本是古老得多的原住民道路与聚落地区的一部分。

english: Etomami is a Cree name meaning “where three rivers join,” referring to the meeting of the Etomami, Red Deer and Fir rivers in eastern Saskatchewan. The Etomami flows north from a lake of the same name through a deeply cut valley. This junction lay on a route through the forested interior used by Indigenous travellers and later by fur traders. In 1691 the Hudson’s Bay Company traveller Henry Kelsey passed the lake while travelling between river systems.
simp_chinese: 埃托马米是克里语名称，意为“三河汇合之处”，指萨斯喀彻温东部埃托马米河、红鹿河和冷杉河的交汇地。埃托马米河从同名湖泊向北流出，穿过深切河谷。汇合处位于穿越森林内陆的道路上，原住民旅人和后来的毛皮商人都使用这条路线。1691年，哈德逊湾公司的旅行者亨利·凯尔西在河流系统之间旅行时经过此湖。

english: Etorofu is a long volcanic island in the southern Kurils, inhabited by Ainu communities whose fishing, hunting, and exchange linked them with neighbouring islands. Its indented coast faces the Sea of Okhotsk on one side and the Pacific on the other. Ainu from the island traded Japanese goods for Russian cloth and furs on nearby Urup. At the end of the eighteenth century, Russian settlement on Urup drew Japanese attention to the southern Kurils. A Japanese expedition reached Etorofu in 1798, and the shogunate took direct control of eastern Ezo in 1799. Officials sought to change Ainu names, dress, and customs, while restricting movement and contact with people from islands farther north.
simp_chinese: 择捉是千岛南部一座狭长的火山岛，岛上阿伊努人以捕鱼、狩猎和交换与邻岛相连。曲折海岸一面临鄂霍次克海，一面朝太平洋；岛民曾到附近得抚岛以日本货物交换俄国布匹和毛皮。 十八世纪末，俄国人在得抚岛的定居引起日本对南千岛的关注。1798年日本探险队抵达择捉，次年幕府直接管理东虾夷地。官员试图改变阿伊努人的姓名、衣着和习俗，并限制他们与北方岛民的往来。

english: Etosha is a vast salt pan in northern Namibia, the remnant of an ancient inland lake. Its pale surface is usually dry, but heavy rains can leave shallow water across the basin before it evaporates again. The Ekuma River brings water south from the Cuvelai drainage, while the Omuramba Owambo also feeds the pan. Around its white floor, springs and grasslands draw herds of antelope and other animals.
simp_chinese: 埃托沙是纳米比亚北部一片广阔的盐沼，也是古代内陆湖的遗迹。苍白的地表通常干燥，但大雨有时会在盆地中形成浅水，随后再次蒸发。埃库马河从库韦莱水系向南带来水流，奥姆兰巴奥万博也注入盐沼。白色盆地周围的泉水和草地吸引着羚羊等动物。

english: The Atrak flows westward from the mountains of northern Khorasan toward the Caspian Sea. Its lower valley borders the open country north of Gorgan, a region associated with the Goklen and Yomut Turkmen. During the reign of the Safavid Shah Tahmasp I, many Goklen moved from the northern bank of the Atrak to the Gorgan River, bringing their flocks into the pastures farther south.
simp_chinese: 阿特雷克河从呼罗珊北部山地向西流向里海。下游河谷毗邻戈尔甘以北的开阔地带，这片地区与戈克兰和约穆特土库曼人密切相关。萨法维沙阿塔赫马斯普一世统治时期，许多戈克兰人从阿特雷克河北岸迁往戈尔甘河，将牲畜带到更南面的牧场。

english:
Etzanoa was a great settlement of the ancestors of the Wichita, near the meeting of the Walnut and Arkansas rivers. Houses covered with grass stood in groups along the river, surrounded by fields where people cultivated maize, beans and squash. The inhabitants also hunted bison and maintained far-reaching exchange networks across the southern Plains.

In 1601 Juan de Oñate led a Spanish expedition from New Mexico to this country. His party encountered people the Spaniards called Rayados and reached a settlement whose inhabitants had withdrawn before their arrival. Oñate turned back toward New Mexico, but on the return journey his men fought a large force of Escanxaque warriors. The account of the expedition preserves a glimpse of a populous Plains society before prolonged European settlement.
simp_chinese:
埃察诺亚是威奇托人祖先的一处大型聚落，位于沃尔纳特河与阿肯色河汇合处附近。覆草房屋沿河成群分布，周围田地种植玉米、豆类和南瓜。居民也猎取野牛，在南部平原上维持广泛的交换网络。

1601年，胡安·德·奥尼亚特率西班牙远征队从新墨西哥来到这一地区。他们遇到西班牙人称为拉亚多斯的居民，并抵达一处居民已在其到来前撤离的聚落。奥尼亚特决定返回新墨西哥，途中其部下与大批埃斯坎沙克战士交战。远征记述保存了欧洲人长期定居之前，人口众多的平原社会的一瞥。

english:
Etzatlán was the centre of an indigenous lordship in the valleys west of Guadalajara. Its domain included nearby settlements and communities around the lake of Atitic. With the arrival of Spanish expeditions in the sixteenth century, the town became a base for both conquest and the establishment of Franciscan missions in western Mexico.

Franciscan friars began building the convent of the Purísima Concepción in 1534. The demands placed on indigenous communities helped provoke resistance, and Etzatlán was drawn into the Mixtón War of 1541. In the following decade its mineral resources attracted colonial miners: silver deposits were registered in 1550, and estates were established to process the ore. Mining later declined in the early seventeenth century, but the town remained a centre of the surrounding district.
simp_chinese:
埃察特兰曾是瓜达拉哈拉以西谷地一个原住民领地的中心，管辖附近聚落及阿蒂蒂克湖周围的社区。十六世纪西班牙远征队抵达后，这座城镇成为征服西墨西哥和建立方济各会传教站的基地。

方济各会修士于 1534 年开始修建圣母无原罪修院。强加于原住民社区的劳役助长了反抗，埃察特兰也被卷入 1541 年的米斯顿战争。此后十年，当地矿产吸引了殖民采矿者：银矿于 1550 年登记，矿石加工庄园相继建立。十七世纪初采矿业衰退，但城镇仍是周边地区的中心。

english: Etzikom Coulee is a broad valley in the grasslands north of the Milk River. Its name comes from a Blackfoot word for a ravine or coulee, a familiar feature of the northern Plains. The coulee drains toward Pakowki Lake, a basin without an outlet whose water level varies with rainfall. This open country lies between the Milk River valley and the higher ground farther north.
simp_chinese: 埃齐科姆沟谷位于米尔克河以北的草原之中，是一条宽阔的谷地。它的名字来自黑脚语中表示沟谷的词，这种地形在北部平原十分常见。沟谷中的水流向帕科基湖，一个没有出水口的湖盆，湖面随降水变化。这片开阔地位于米尔克河谷与更北方的高地之间。

english: ʻEua is a high island southeast of Tongatapu, with a rugged ridge and steep cliffs above the Pacific. Its communities belonged to the Tongan world of chiefs and inter-island voyages. Abel Tasman sighted ʻEua in 1643 and called it Middelburg; James Cook visited the island during his second Pacific voyage in 1773.
simp_chinese: 埃瓦是汤加塔布东南方的高岛，崎岖山脊与陡崖耸立于太平洋之上。岛上社群属于汤加的首领与岛际航行世界。1643年，阿贝尔·塔斯曼望见埃瓦，称其为米德尔堡；詹姆斯·库克于1773年第二次太平洋航行中到访。

english: The Euboic Sea separates Euboea from the Greek mainland, narrowing at Chalcis into the Euripus Strait. A bridge has linked the shores at this constriction since Byzantine times. Known to westerners as Negroponte, Chalcis became a center of Venetian and Latin rule after the Fourth Crusade. The Ottomans captured the fortified town after a long siege in 1470, and held it against a Venetian attempt to recover it in 1688.
simp_chinese: 埃维亚海将埃维亚岛与希腊大陆隔开，在哈尔基斯附近收窄为欧里波斯海峡。拜占庭时代，这处狭口已有桥梁连接两岸。西方人称哈尔基斯为内格罗蓬特，第四次十字军东征后，它成为威尼斯与拉丁领主统治的中心。1470年奥斯曼人经过长期围攻夺取这座设防城镇，并于1688年击退了威尼斯的收复企图。

english: The Eucla coast faces the Great Australian Bight near the western edge of the Nullarbor Plain. Long cliffs and exposed shores border the ocean, forming part of Mirning country. The Mirning people's connections to this coast and its sea extend far beyond the arrival of European ships in southern Australian waters.
simp_chinese: 尤克拉海岸面向大澳大利亚湾，靠近纳拉伯平原西缘。漫长的悬崖与无遮蔽海岸临海而立，属于米尔宁人的土地。米尔宁人与这段海岸及海洋的联系远早于欧洲船只抵达澳大利亚南部水域。

english: Eufaula was one of several Creek towns along the lower Chattahoochee River. Its settlements spread at different times along both banks, linked by paths to nearby Sawokli and to other communities on the Flint and Pea rivers. Maps recorded the town as Uphale by the 1730s. Around the turn of the nineteenth century, Indian agent Benjamin Hawkins described its inhabitants as farmers and cattle herders, with fields enclosed by fences.
simp_chinese: 尤法拉是查特胡奇河下游的克里克村镇之一。它的聚落在不同时期分布于河流两岸，道路将其与邻近的萨沃克利，以及弗林特河和皮河沿岸的其他社群相连。到十八世纪三十年代，地图上已将此地记作乌法利。十九世纪前后，印第安事务官本杰明·霍金斯记载，当地居民耕种田地、饲养牛群，并用篱笆围起农田。

english: Punta Eugenia projects westward from the Vizcaíno Peninsula into the Pacific, marking the southern end of the great curve of Sebastián Vizcaíno Bay. Cedros Island lies offshore to the north, beyond the cape and its neighboring islands. Across the bay, the waters reach the sheltered lagoon of Ojo de Liebre. The cape forms a conspicuous turning point on a long, dry coast of dunes and low mountains along the Baja California Peninsula.
simp_chinese: 欧亨尼娅角从比斯开诺半岛向西伸入太平洋，是塞瓦斯蒂安·比斯开诺湾巨大弧形海岸的南端。岬角及附近岛屿以北的海面上是塞德罗斯岛；海湾另一侧的水域通向避风的奥霍德利布雷潟湖。这座岬角是下加利福尼亚半岛漫长干旱海岸上的醒目标志，沿岸可见沙丘和低矮山地。

english:
Eumseong lay among the inland routes linking the Han, Geum and Nakdong river basins. In 1413, Joseon administrative reform placed a hyeongam, or county magistrate, over this small district formerly dependent on Chungju. Its modest resources could make royal administration burdensome: in 1541, officials complained that frequent changes of magistrate and the expense of receiving and seeing off their households had exhausted a county with few inhabitants and clerks. They proposed restricting the officials' accompanying families until the district recovered.

The county's Confucian school gave this administrative centre a second focus. Its endowed lands and books supported instruction as well as ceremonies honouring Confucian sages; one instructor served an assigned body of thirty students. Repairs to its Myeongnyundang lecture hall in 1651 mark the continued upkeep of this local institution. Eumseong's surviving record thus includes both the costs of governing a small county and the resources devoted to maintaining its learned and ritual life.
simp_chinese:
阴城位于连接汉江、锦江与洛东江流域的内陆通道之间。1413年，朝鲜王朝改革地方行政，在原属忠州的这片小县设置县监。地方财力有限，官府往来便可能成为沉重负担：1541年，朝廷官员指出，县监频繁更替，迎送官员及其家属的开支，使吏少民寡的阴城愈发凋敝，因此建议暂时限制守令携眷赴任，让县民休养。

县内乡校则把地方行政中心与儒学教育连接起来。官府配置田地与书籍，供教学及祭祀先贤之用，一名教官负责定额三十名学生。1651年修缮明伦堂，显示这一地方学宫仍在持续维护。阴城留下的具体记录，既有小县承受的治理成本，也有维持读书与礼仪生活的投入。

english: Eura is a general name recorded for several Aboriginal peoples of southern Australia, including the Ngadjuri and Nukunu. Their lands encompass parts of the southern Flinders Ranges and the country east of Spencer Gulf. Hills, seasonal creeks and gum woodland form a landscape in which neighbouring groups maintained distinct languages and connections to country.
simp_chinese: 尤拉是南澳大利亚数个原住民人群的统称记录，其中包括恩加朱里人和努库努人。他们的土地涵盖南弗林德斯山脉及斯潘塞湾以东部分地区。丘陵、季节性溪流与桉树林构成当地景观，邻近群体各自保持语言及与土地的联系。

english: Europa is a low coral island in the Mozambique Channel, between Madagascar and the African mainland. A reef and sandy beaches surround the island, while a broad mangrove forest fringes its northeastern lagoon. Seabirds nest ashore and green turtles come to lay their eggs. In December 1774 the crew of the British ship Europa gave the island the name of their vessel; in 1828 a French navigator proposed calling it Île d'Europe.
simp_chinese: 欧罗巴岛是莫桑比克海峡中一座低平的珊瑚岛，位于马达加斯加与非洲大陆之间。礁石和沙滩环绕岛屿，东北部的潟湖岸边长着大片红树林。海鸟在陆地筑巢，绿海龟上岸产卵。1774年12月，英国船只“欧罗巴”号的船员以船名为岛屿命名；1828年，一位法国航海者提议称之为欧洲岛。

english:
Eutin stands beside a lake in eastern Holstein. Its name is Slavic, and the Abodrites built a stronghold on an island in the Great Eutin Lake. After the counts of Holstein conquered the region in the twelfth century, settlers arrived from northern Germany and the Netherlands. Eutin became a market in 1156 and received town rights in 1257. Around 1300 it became a residence of the bishops of Lübeck.

The bishops' town later enjoyed a flourishing cultural life. Between 1776 and 1829 writers and thinkers including Johann Heinrich Voss and Friedrich Leopold zu Stolberg formed the Eutin circle; the composer Carl Maria von Weber was born here in 1786. The ecclesiastical principality was secularized in 1803, and Eutin passed with its territory to the house of Oldenburg.
simp_chinese:
奥伊廷坐落在荷尔斯泰因东部的一座湖畔，地名源自斯拉夫语。阿波德里特人曾在大奥伊廷湖中的岛上修筑堡垒。十二世纪，荷尔斯泰因伯爵征服这一地区后，来自北德意志和尼德兰的移民陆续定居。奥伊廷于1156年成为集市，1257年获得城市权，约1300年成为吕贝克主教的驻地。

主教驻地后来迎来了文化繁荣。1776至1829年间，约翰·海因里希·福斯和弗里德里希·利奥波德·楚·施托尔贝格等作家与思想家在此组成奥伊廷文人圈；作曲家卡尔·玛丽亚·冯·韦伯也于1786年出生在这里。1803年，教会采邑被世俗化，奥伊廷连同其领地转归奥尔登堡家族。

english: Evans Strait separates Coats Island from the Bell Peninsula of Southampton Island at the northern end of Hudson Bay. In late spring and summer, walrus gather on the floating pack ice in the strait; as the ice recedes, they also haul out on nearby islands. The Sallirmiut lived on and around Southampton, Coats and Walrus islands, hunting the animals of the surrounding waters. West of Evans Strait, Fisher Strait forms another passage between the two larger islands.
simp_chinese: 埃文斯海峡位于哈得孙湾北端，将科茨岛与南安普顿岛的贝尔半岛分开。晚春和夏季，海象聚集在海峡浮冰上；冰消退后，它们也会爬上附近的岛屿休息。萨利尔米乌特人生活在南安普顿岛、科茨岛和海象岛一带，猎取周围水域的动物。埃文斯海峡以西，菲舍尔海峡也是两座大岛之间的通路。

english: Evenksk lies in the country of the Bolshaya Garmanda, a river descending from the Kolyma Highlands to Nayakhan Bay on the Sea of Okhotsk. Its lower course reaches the coastal plain and forms an estuary. Even and Koryak people travelled through this northeastern country in small groups before Russian expansion reached the region in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. The river links the coast with the mountain valleys inland.
simp_chinese: 埃文克斯克位于大加尔曼达河地区。这条河从科雷马高地流下，注入鄂霍次克海的纳亚汉湾；下游进入海岸平原，形成河口湾。十七至十八世纪俄国势力抵达之前，埃文人和科里亚克人已分成小群体穿行于这片东北地区。河流将海岸与内陆山谷连接起来。

english: Évian lies on the southern shore of Lake Geneva, beneath the mountains of Savoy. Its lakeside position made it a stopping place between the Alpine valleys and the towns around the lake. In 1789–1790 Jean-Charles de Laizer helped establish the reputation of a spring in the Cachat family's garden, whose water he believed had improved his health. The spring would bring new visitors to a town long connected to the lake and its traffic.
simp_chinese: 埃维昂坐落在日内瓦湖南岸，背靠萨伏依群山。湖滨位置使它成为阿尔卑斯谷地与湖畔城镇之间的歇脚处。1789至1790年间，让-夏尔·德·莱泽使卡沙家花园中的泉水获得声誉，他相信饮用泉水改善了自己的健康。这处泉源后来为长期与湖泊交通相连的城镇带来了新的访客。

english: Evinayong lies among the forested hills of mainland Equatorial Guinea. The surrounding interior is part of a wider region inhabited by Fang-speaking communities, whose connections extend across the forest country. River valleys link this upland landscape with the coastal lowlands to the west.
simp_chinese: 埃维纳永位于赤道几内亚大陆地区森林覆盖的山丘之间。周围内陆属于说芳语社群居住的更广阔地区，各社群的联系遍及森林土地。河谷将这片高地与西方的沿海低地连接起来。

english:
Évreux, a bishop's seat and the capital of its own county, was an important town in eastern Normandy. Its cathedral of Notre-Dame and the abbey of Saint-Taurin stood at the heart of its religious life, while royal officers and the counts of Évreux made it a centre of government. The counts' connections with Navarre drew the town into the politics of two kingdoms.

In the fourteenth century Charles II of Navarre, count of Évreux, pursued his ambitions amid the Hundred Years' War. Fighting between French and Navarrese forces damaged the town, and the cathedral needed repairs after a fire in 1356. English troops captured Évreux in 1418; occupation and destruction were followed by a slow recovery. Work on the cathedral continued through the following centuries and reached completion in the early seventeenth century.
simp_chinese:
埃夫勒是主教驻地和同名伯国的首府，也是诺曼底东部的重要城镇。圣母主教座堂与圣托兰修道院是当地宗教生活的中心；王室官员和埃夫勒伯爵则使这里成为行政中心。伯爵家族与纳瓦拉的联系，又将城市卷入两个王国的政治。

十四世纪，纳瓦拉国王兼埃夫勒伯爵查理二世在百年战争中追逐自己的政治抱负。法国与纳瓦拉军队之间的战斗损害了城镇，主教座堂在1356年的火灾后也须修复。英军于1418年占领埃夫勒，战乱破坏之后是缓慢的复兴。主教座堂的工程延续了几个世纪，至十七世纪初才完成。

english:
Evueví, commonly known as Payaguá, were canoe-using people of the Paraguay River country, including the upper river and Pantanal. Their name is associated with “people of the water.” Rivers were their routes and a source of power, rather than simply obstacles to movement. Spanish and Portuguese expansion into the Chaco and Mato Grosso challenged their control of these waters.

In the 1720s and 1730s, Payaguá attacks disrupted the river expeditions linking Portuguese settlements with Mato Grosso. The conflict escalated in 1732, when a royal order authorised war against them; later that year warfare was extended to other Indigenous peoples along the Cuiabá route. The struggle over navigation also carried the threat of enslavement, since colonists sought captives under the language of “just war.” River knowledge and mobility were central to Evueví resistance against these expanding colonial networks.
simp_chinese:
Evueví通常被称为Payaguá，是活动于巴拉圭河流域、包括上游与潘塔纳尔地区的舟居族群，其自称与“水之民”有关。河流既是行动路线，也是力量的来源。西班牙和葡萄牙向查科及马托格罗索扩张，对他们控制水路的能力构成挑战。

1720至1730年代，Payaguá的袭击打断了连接葡萄牙聚落与马托格罗索的河运远征。1732年，王室命令准许对其开战，同年稍后又将战争扩大到库亚巴路沿线的其他原住民。航运争夺同时伴随着奴役威胁，殖民者以“正义战争”为名寻求俘虏。熟悉河道与善于机动，成为Evueví抵抗殖民网络扩张的重要条件。
